The Defender API is used by the Microsoft Defender XDR portal (security.microsoft.com) for managing security operations, including:

  - Alerts and Incidents
  - Advanced Hunting
  - Endpoint Device Management (MDE)
  - Live Response
  - Endpoint Configuration
  - Vulnerability Management (TVM)
  - Identity Protection (MDI)
  - Configuration and Settings
  - Exposure Management and XSPM
  - Data Lake and Analytics
  - Threat Analytics
  - Action Center
  - Streaming API

These APIs are accessed through the Defender XDR portal's API proxy layer at
`security.microsoft.com/apiproxy` and support delegated authentication flows.
They are used internally by the Defender XDR portal and are not
officially documented by Microsoft.

The proxy layer routes requests to various backend services using path prefixes:

| Prefix | Service |
| --- | --- |
| `/mtp/` | Microsoft Threat Protection |
| `/mdi/` | Microsoft Defender for Identity |
| `/aatp/` | Azure Advanced Threat Protection (MDI legacy) |
| `/mcas/` | Microsoft Cloud App Security (Defender for Cloud Apps) |
| `/mdc/` | Microsoft Defender for Cloud |
| `/securityplatform/` | Security Platform (Data Lake) |
| `/radius/` | RADIUS Identity Services |
| `/di/` | Data Infrastructure (shared with Purview) |
| `/gws/` | Governance Web Services (shared with Purview) |
| `/medeina/` | Security Copilot (shared with Purview) |
| `/cdssecuritycopilot/` | CDS Security Copilot (legacy, see /medeina/) |
| `/msgraph/` | Microsoft Graph Proxy (shared with Purview) |
| `/shell/` | Portal Shell (shared with Purview) |
| `/astgws/` | Attack Simulator Gateway |
| `/m365appprotection/` | App Governance |
| `/ndr/` | Network Detection & Response |

The separate Defender XDR (MTO) specification documents the multi-tenant
organization view at `mto.security.microsoft.com`, including `/mtoapi/`
wrappers around native Defender services.

**Cross-portal shared services:** Several backend services are shared with the Microsoft Purview portal (purview.microsoft.com).
The `/di/`, `/gws/`, `/medeina/`, `/msgraph/`, and `/shell/` prefixes route to the same backend services in both portals,
though each portal may expose different subsets of endpoints.

Documentation and specifications have been provided on a best efforts basis and may not be 100% accurate.
